text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, in keeping with the promise we made that day,
I came to watch the Arima Kinen
together with Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Gotta be Buena!” “Totally agree.”
“Isn't it Pisa's turn?” “Rulership might take it though.”
“I’m putting my faith in Flash!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"'...If only Rose were running.
She was so great in the Japan Cup, after all.'
'Yeah, it really is a shame.'"
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, the spectator stands are—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to burn it into my memory from up close.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In this year-end Grand Prix—upon that grand stage, what will be achieved, and what will slip away?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: They're off! In the battle for the lead, number 4, Tosen Jordan, makes the first move—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
200 meters to go, and Victoire Pisa takes the lead!
—Here comes Buena Vista from the far outside!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What I couldn't deliver at the Japan Cup...
I will, without fail, claim it right here—!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A circle of unity that reaches all across Japan—!
YAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista and Victoire Pisa...!
Crossing the finish line side by side!!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
They cross the line together—
Did Victoire Pisa just barely hold on?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Congrats, Pisa!!” “That was the best!”
“Way to hold on by a nose!!”
“Great run, Buena!” “What an explosive finishing kick!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Flash!” “Great effort out there~!”
“Ruler!” “Get 'em next time!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Man, now I’m seriously hyped for next year!”
“The possibilities are endless!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... Had I been able to run as well, how much more attention
would have been bestowed upon our house?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... How foolish. "What ifs" are entirely meaningless.
I must simply never forget this bitterness.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Etch the cheers into your ears. Sear them into your heart.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I had a bouquet prepared for today's victor.
Could you deliver it to Pisa for me?
choice_data_list: May I be the one to present it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please.
...Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you so much...!
What a wonderful fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please tell Rose-san that I eagerly await
the day we face each other next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Arima Kinen,
having witnessed firsthand the fierce battle and the deep emotion it stirred—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An entirely unforeseen press conference was held.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after the New Year,
we advanced our piece to the Nikkei Shinshun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Murmur...!*)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "The Nikkei Shinshun Hai... That's the race Rose Kingdom-san is targeting next after bypassing the Arima Kinen, right?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Is it her presence, after all?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. You are well aware, are you not?
Of the fated rivalry between my alma mater
and the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Both of our camps possess considerable history.
We have crossed paths at the racecourse from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In particular, Air Groove-san—a revered senior from my alma mater—
battled a horse girl of that famed Rose Clan for the crown at the Japanese Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The very person who thwarted the fulfillment of our long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Air Groove hailed from the same Umamusume training academy as Rulership, standing as something of an elder sister figure to her. Bearing the moniker of 'Empress,' she was a contender of formidable power.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How quickly the years have passed since then.
Fate is truly a fickle thing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
During the Classic campaign, when there was a gap in ability,
she had played the role of a rival,
but in the Senior year, the story changes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My hand is set.
Come early spring, bearing the academy on my shoulders,
I shall bring the Rose clan down once more.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
History turns full circle, and fate repeats itself.
...I know you're listening, Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Ruler.
choice_data_list: History moves in cycles, and destiny repeats itself... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...She is not that sort of person.
I doubt she cares in the slightest for the ties and grudges of history.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There must be another reason for her entering the race.
Was it necessary for her plan, or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...
Still, well—speaking for myself personally.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Your absence is regrettable beyond measure.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Despite how she appears, she is surprisingly kind.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Perhaps she means to slap some sense into me, telling me to focus on the bout directly before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there is no knowing the absolute truth.
Yet if that truly were the case—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to dance upon a stage so gracefully prepared
would be nothing short of discourtesy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Phew, alright!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Scrutinize the training regimen.
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai... let us make it
our revenge match against that academy.
